exceptions.reason: No patched braces exists (every version through 3.0.3, the latest, is affected), and every micromatch and fast-glob release depends on it. It reaches the frontend only through eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob@3.3.1 -> micromatch, which expands this repository's own glob patterns while linting. It is never part of the Next build output or the running app, and the stack exhaustion needs an attacker-controlled pattern.
exceptions.exitCriterion: A patched braces is published, or @next/eslint-plugin-next stops depending on fast-glob/micromatch; then update and remove this entry.
